title: English Practice Quiz 0401
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Please close ___ door.
questions.explanation: The refers to a specific door known to the speaker and listener.

questions.question: Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.

questions.question: How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.

questions.question: A polite way to disagree is:
options: I see your point, but I have a different view.
questions.explanation: This phrase acknowledges the other person before presenting a different view.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I like tea, coffee and milk.
I like tea coffee and milk
I like, tea coffee, and milk.
i like tea, coffee and milk
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list and capitalise the first word.

questions.question: If I had more time, I ___ another language.
questions.explanation: The second conditional uses would + base verb for an unreal or imagined situation.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: ___ student must bring an ID card.
questions.explanation: Each refers to every individual in a group.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.
